tasks.short: Attend photo shoots and printing sessions

steps.what: List the products needed at the sessions
Check the print file against printing rules
Attend the photo shoots and watch the set
Attend the printing sessions for those products
Confirm the needed products were obtained
File the shoot sheets with no face tags

tasks.design: A {DOCS} list names the products needed at the photo shoots and printing sessions. A checker compares the print file with the written print rules before the session and does not decide the result. The art director attends both, confirms what was obtained, and files contact sheets in {CMS} with no automatic face tags.
tasks.previous_blocker: The needed products were a verbal list, so a missed item showed up only on the floor.
tasks.enabler_now: Shot id, product id and print file id can be written down before the day.
tasks.still_hard: Being on the shoot and at the press is still the only way to see the products.
tasks.human_edge: The art director confirms that the needed products were obtained. A rule report does not do that.
tasks.altitude: The list and the file check happen before the day. Attendance stays. The art director can stop a sheet from being stored with a face tag.

reach.task: Chase only the products the art director marked missing
reach.learn: Which products were obtained and which print mismatches were already listed

evidence.claim: Photo shoots and printing sessions are attended in person. A list and a file check can be ready beforehand. They do not replace the visit.
Digest [S5] says a prepress checker compares a file to print rules and reports each mismatch. It does not decide whether the products were obtained.
Digest [S4] says face recognition on an asset library can suggest a name from earlier tags, and a person confirms. This design does not auto-tag a person's face.
Digest [S15] says GDPR article 9 bans face recognition in an archive without explicit consent, and a data-protection assessment comes first. This design does not auto-tag a person's face.

assumptions: Focal role is the art director. The task is attendance until the products are confirmed. Booking the photographer is out of scope.
Input contract: shoot id, product id, print file id, needed quantity. Producer is the art director from the layout spec. If a product id is missing it is typed on the day and marked manual.
Use the print profile and the asset store's file fields before custom code. Contact sheets store file name and shot id only. No face recognition runs.
unknowns: Whether the press visit can be skipped when the rule report is clean.
Who else may confirm products on site.
research_questions: How often is a needed product missing on the day?
How often would a face tag have been applied by habit?

already_counted.description: Time on the photo shoots stays with the art director
Time at the printing sessions stays with the art director

incremental.description: Keep the product checklist fields aligned with new shoot types

approvals.approved_version: product note confirming what was obtained at these sessions
the same product note, stored without face tags

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes product lists stay verbal, so only the habit of not tagging faces is new. The high case assumes a clean list and a rule report, while both sessions and the confirmation still take their full time. The photographer's fee is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the illustrative material and the standards
Compare measurable fields to the specifications
Review illustrative material that the check flagged
Determine if the material conforms to standards
File the standards decision for this material

tasks.design: Illustrative material and the written standards sit in {DOCS}. A check compares measurable fields, such as size and required labels, with the specifications and only lists gaps. The art director reviews the material and determines whether it conforms. That decision is filed in {PROJECT}. The check does not decide.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standards were a prose page, so a pass could not separate a wrong size from a weak picture.
tasks.enabler_now: Size, colour profile and required labels can be fields a file can be compared with.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the material conforms in character is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The art director determines if the illustrative material conforms. The variance list does not.

ambition.what: Record a conform decision each time illustrative material arrives, not only in a weekly pile

tasks.altitude: Measurable gaps are listed first. The conform decision stays. The art director can send material back when a required field is blank.

reach.task: Correct illustrative material the art director said did not conform
reach.learn: Which specifications failed and which failures were accepted

evidence.claim: Reviewing illustrative material is mostly reading and a decision. Only measurable specification fields can be compared without a person.
Digest [S5] says a prepress checker compares a file to print rules and reports each mismatch. It does not decide the design. The same limit applies to a standards check.

assumptions: Focal role is the art director. The task ends at the conform decision. Redrawing the material is a later task.
Input contract: material id, standard id, width, height, colour profile, required label ids. Producer is the staff designer. Rows with no standard id are not compared and wait for a manual link.
Configure the comparison against the existing specification fields before custom code. Taste and character stay manual.
unknowns: Which standards are written as fields and which are still prose.
Whether colour profile is even relevant for this material.
research_questions: What share of failures are measurable field misses?
How often does the art director accept a material that failed a field?

already_counted.description: Reading the illustrative material stays with the art director
The conform decision stays with the art director

incremental.description: Add a specification field when a new standard is written down

approvals.approved_version: conform decision for this illustrative material

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes standards stay as prose, so the field check rarely runs and the art director still reads everything. The high case assumes measurable fields are clean but the conform decision is still taken by the art director. Redrawing is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Hire, train and direct staff who make layouts

steps.what: Draft the role note for design layouts
Select staff members who will develop layouts
Train staff members on layouts for printing
Direct staff who develop design concepts
File the assignment after the hiring decision

tasks.design: A {DOCS} role note lists the layouts and printing work the seat covers. The art director selects staff members in an interview, trains them, and directs them while they develop design concepts. The assignment is filed in {PROJECT}. No tool watches staff at work.
tasks.previous_blocker: The role was a verbal description, so training and directing started from different memories of the job.
tasks.enabler_now: Craft, layout types and printing duties can be fields on one role note.
tasks.still_hard: Hiring, training and directing people stay in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The art director selects the person and directs the work. A form does not hire.
tasks.altitude: The role note is ready before the interview. The interview, the training and the directing stay. The art director can refuse an assignment that has no named person.

reach.task: Develop design concepts into the layouts named in the assignment
reach.learn: Which layouts they own and who directs the work

evidence.claim: Hiring, training and directing are people work. A role note can be prepared. The conversations cannot be handed to a tool.
Digest [S16] says the Dutch works council must consent before a tool watches staff at work, and an objection can void it. This task does not watch staff, so that consent step is not used.

assumptions: Focal role is the art director. The task covers hire, train and direct for this seat. Payroll and contracts sit with another role.
Input contract: role id, layout types, printing duties, team. Producer is the art director. If layout types are blank the note is finished by hand and marked manual.
Use the document template for the role note before custom code. The design does not log keystrokes, screens or location of staff.
unknowns: Whether a works council would still want a notice because a role note stores staff names.
Who may hire when the art director is away.
research_questions: How often is a new person directed with no written assignment?
How long is the training before the person prepares layouts alone?

already_counted.description: Interview time stays with the art director
Directing staff on live work stays with the art director

incremental.description: Revise the role note when layout types or printing duties change

approvals.approved_version: hiring decision for this role id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes the role stays verbal, so only the filed assignment is new. The high case assumes a clean role note, while the interview, the training and the directing still take their full time. The new person's later output is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research design trends and printing technology

steps.what: Research current trends in printing technology
Summarise printing production techniques and software

loop.input: source list and the note template
loop.output: a note where each sentence cites one source link
loop.check: Every sentence contains a source link from the list
loop.stop: One pass; delete any sentence with no link
loop.why_not_simpler: Whether a technique matters here is not a lookup

steps.what: Open each source and judge the design trends
File the trends note the art director accepted

tasks.design: The art director searches current trends in printing technology, production techniques and software. An answer note in {DOCS} may summarise only pages it cites. The art director opens every cited source and judges it before the note is filed in {PROJECT}. Uncited sentences are dropped.
tasks.previous_blocker: Trend notes were unsourced clippings, so a later reader could not tell a real technique from a rumour.
tasks.enabler_now: A note can be required to carry a source link on each claim.
tasks.still_hard: Judging which trend matters for this studio is still the art director's call.
tasks.human_edge: The art director opens the sources and decides which design trends to keep.

ambition.what: File a sourced trends note every week, not only when a new job starts

tasks.altitude: Searching is shorter. Reading and judging stay. The art director can reject a note that cites nothing.

reach.task: Try only the techniques the trends note kept
reach.learn: Which sources were opened and which trends were rejected

evidence.claim: Trend research is reading. A note can cite the pages it used. The art director still opens those pages and chooses.
Digest [S8] is a commentary that generative tools change craft and that a person still directs the work. It is not a measured saving, and it does not choose a trend.

assumptions: Focal role is the art director. The task ends at the filed trends note. Adopting a technique is a later task.
Input contract: topic, source link, date read, keep or drop. Producer is the art director. A claim with no source link is dropped, not repaired by guesswork.
Use the document store's link fields before custom code. The art director opens every link the note cites.
unknowns: Which sources the firm is allowed to store.
How far back a trend note should look.
research_questions: What share of trend claims in old notes had no source?
How often does the art director drop a claim after opening the link?

already_counted.description: Reading and judging sources stays with the art director
Editing the sourced draft stays with the art director

incremental.description: Retire source links that no longer resolve and replace the template line

approvals.approved_version: trends note accepted after the sources were opened

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes sources are not linkable, so the art director still clips by hand and the draft rarely qualifies. The high case assumes links resolve but every source is still opened and judged. Buying software named in a note is not counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week still goes to shoots, printing sessions, hiring and the conform decision, with less time spent hunting trend sources or measurable spec gaps.
reach: Printers receive a product list before the session, and the art director still attends.
Staff designers learn which illustrative material conformed and why.
A new designer receives a filed assignment rather than only a verbal one.
skills_to_grow: Compare illustrative material with a written specification before the taste call.
Keep a trend note tied to sources that were opened.
Hire and direct staff without a tool that watches them at work.
role.ambitious_version: Trend notes cite opened sources, illustrative material has a recorded conform decision, and photo files are stored without face tags.
